I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is semantic versioning, in major.minor.patch format. It gives the recorded reason: semver signals compatibility, so users can tell breaking changes from minor updates.

The decision comes from the project's recorded decision log. An earlier CalVer decision (observation 14) was replaced by the semver decision (observation 15). I left CalVer out of the file, as you asked.

The repository itself records nothing on versioning. A search for "semver", "calver" and "version scheme" found no matches, and the only existing doc, `docs/doc.md`, is the Gin quick start. I read only the first 1,889 of its 2,667 lines, but the search covered the whole file.

I haven't committed anything.
